text:
Maya Lin: hi everyone — first week here! hitting two blockers with cloud access, can someone point me to the right person?
Maya Lin: 1) In GCP I can't see the billing account for project 'redwood-staging' (console shows "Billing account not found"). 2) In AWS my IAM role doesn't let me create or describe lambdas (says AccessDenied for role 'Redwood-Developer').
Maya Lin: I tried the usual console routes and gcloud auth, but no dice. cc @Charlie Nguyen @Alex Perez :wave:
Alex Perez: hey Maya — welcome! for AWS ping me, I'll check roles. what's your aws account id (the one in the console top-right)?
Maya Lin: Account ID 123456789012
Alex Perez: thanks. I can see your session, looks like you're missing the AWS managed policy we attach. I'll trigger a role update, should be quick. If you still see AccessDenied after 5–10m, DM me.
Charlie Nguyen: for GCP billing, billing access is handled by finance/security. Sarah can approve linking projects to billing accounts. @Sarah O'Neill can you confirm the process for a new hire linking staging?
Sarah O'Neill: yup — new hires need billing.user on the billing account + project/billing.admin on the project OR we can link on your behalf. Please open an access request at https://access.redwood.com (choose "Cloud Billing") and include the project id and reason.
Maya Lin: thanks — putting in the request now. do you need the billing account id too?
Sarah O'Neill: prefer the billing account id if you have it, but the billing page URL or project id is fine. Also copy your manager to speed approval.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: please complete the cloud access intake form within 1 business day to avoid delays. <https://access.redwood.com/form|access.redwood.com/form>
Alex Perez: I pushed the policy change — try `aws sts get-caller-identity` then `aws lambda list-functions` and paste any error if it persists.
Maya Lin: ran those, lambda list works now 🎉 no more AccessDenied. Thanks Alex!
Maya Lin: Sarah — request submitted with project id redwood-staging and billing acct BA-9876. pinged my manager too.
Sarah O'Neill: got it, approving now. should be linked in <30m. I'll post when done.
Charlie Nguyen: once linked, you might need to re-open the console or re-auth `gcloud auth login`. if you need a quick command to validate roles:
Charlie Nguyen: ```
# check effective IAM bindings for project
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-staging --flatten="bindings[].members" --format='table(bindings.role, bindings.members)'
```
Maya Lin: perfect, thanks all — appreciate the quick help :pray:
Sarah O'Neill: linked the billing account, you should see billing info and be able to create budgets. let us know if anything else blocks you.
